text: Comprehensive documentation for all aspects of graphtor-docs: architecture overview, data pipeline stages (acquire/parse/embed/load), MCP tool reference, configuration guide (sources.yaml schema, all source types), CLI command reference, developer setup guide, embedding model details (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 via Candle), CozoDB schema and query patterns, incremental sync design, and troubleshooting guide. Should cover both user-facing (how to configure and run) and developer-facing (how to contribute and extend) perspectives. Output: docs/ directory with well-structured markdown files.

PDFium-render dual backend for large PDF ingestion: Replace pdf-extract with pdfium-render for PDFs ≥20 MiB. PDFium opens documents lazily (instant for any size) vs pdf-extract's lopdf which eagerly parses all xref entries serially (>20 min for 104 MB). Implementation: PdfiumBackend struct with try_parse() fallback pattern, DLL discovery via env var → exe dir → system path. Already benchmarked: pdf-extract DNF on Cosmos DB PDF, pdfium-render expected <10s. Dependency: pdfium-render 0.9.1 (thread_safe, pdfium_latest features). Feature branch exists: feat/pdfium-large-pdf-backend with partial implementation.
